## `anova_table(result: holocron.models.postfit.AnovaResult, *, table_id: str = 'anova', title: str = 'ANOVA term tests') -> holocron.reporting.specification.TableSpec`

Adapt joint Wald tests in their declared formula-term order.

## `contrast_table(estimates: collections.abc.Iterable[holocron.models.postfit.InferenceEstimate], *, table_id: str = 'contrasts', title: str = 'Contrasts') -> holocron.reporting.specification.TableSpec`

Adapt named inference estimates to a structured contrast table.

## `diagnostic_table(result: holocron.models.diagnostics.InfluenceResult | holocron.models.diagnostics.RobustnessDiagnostics | holocron.models.diagnostics.PenaltyTraceResult | collections.abc.Iterable[holocron.models.diagnostics.VarianceInflationFactor], *, table_id: str = 'diagnostics', title: str = 'Model diagnostics') -> holocron.reporting.specification.TableSpec`

Adapt supported influence, robustness, penalty, or VIF diagnostics.

## `escape_latex(value: str) -> str`

Escape caller-controlled text for ordinary LaTeX text contexts.

## `format_cell(value: None | int | float | str, column: holocron.reporting.specification.TableColumn) -> str`

Format one raw cell according to its declared column policy.

## `model_summary_table(summary: holocron.models.postfit.ModelSummary, *, table_id: str = 'model-summary', title: str = 'Model coefficient summary') -> holocron.reporting.specification.TableSpec`

Adapt one supported model summary without recomputing inference.

## `render_latex(spec: holocron.reporting.specification.TableSpec, *, include_table_environment: bool = True) -> str`

Render a dependency-free LaTeX fragment from only a :class:`TableSpec`.

Caller-controlled text is always escaped. When ``include_table_environment``
is false, the result is only the ``tabular`` environment for embedding in a
caller-owned float or document.

## `resample_report_table(report: holocron.validation.reporting.ResampleReport, *, table_id: str = 'resample-report', title: str = 'Resample execution') -> holocron.reporting.specification.TableSpec`

Adapt exact resample counts and per-metric coverage to a table.

## `validation_table(result: holocron.validation.probability.ProbabilityValidationResult | holocron.models.survival_validation.SurvivalValidationResult | holocron.validation.optimism.OptimismCorrectedValidationResult, *, table_id: str = 'validation', title: str = 'Validation results') -> holocron.reporting.specification.TableSpec`

Adapt probability, survival, or optimism-corrected validation results.
